تنتجعوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَجِعُوا (tantajiʕū) /tan.ta.d͡ʒi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
# تُنْتَجَعُوا (tuntajaʕū) /tun.ta.d͡ʒa.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَعَ (intajaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
